title: coffee notes — pm / eng 1:1 prep (Nora)
body:
Context:
- Quick 1:1 with Liam (eng lead) — 30 minutes. Goal: align on short-term priorities for API, Console UX changes for dedicated customers, and the private deployment checklist for Q2 customers. High-level ask: unblock the canary rollout for v2 batching kernels and confirm fallback policy for private clusters.

Goals for this meeting:
- Confirm go/no-go criteria for canary (latency regression <= 5% p95, no increase in error rate)
- Agree on short-term Console changes (route visibility + per-model billing line items) needed for sales demos
- Decide owner & ETA for private deployment KMS integration checks
- Surface one risk that needs immediate attention and one small win to highlight to execs

Agenda (timeboxed):
- 0:00–03:00 — quick status recap (Liam)
- 03:00–12:00 — canary health and metrics (focus: p50/p95, tail latency, error spikes)
- 12:00–18:00 — Console UX: billing rows + route-level tracing visibility (impact on dashboards)
- 18:00–24:00 — Private deploy checklist: KMS + network egress review + audit log retention
- 24:00–28:00 — Risks/blocks and tradeoffs (cost vs latency on quantized variants)
- 28:00–30:00 — action items + owners + follow-ups

Key questions I want answered (sharp):
1) Canary: do current A/B metrics include KV cache warmup? If not, how do we account for it in the 5% threshold?
2) Console: is adding per-route billing rows a backend-only change or does it need UI/UX time? Rough dev estimate?
3) Dedicated: are there any capacity constraints for the reserved pools next week that should change our rollouts?
4) Private: what remains for KMS integration? Are we blocked on a security review or infra work?

Notes to self (fragments + quick checks):
- Watch for tail latency spikes after 200ms mark — correlate with batching window (200ms default).
- If A/B shows steady 3–5% p95 lift but tokens cost down by 12%, trade-off ok for now -> capture decision in rollout notes.
- Pull the tracing id for last failed canary run: trace id 67a4f2 (ask Liam).
- Remind: Customer A (enterprise private) asked for HSM key binding by end of month — likely Q2 blocker if not done.

Proposed decisions I want to land in meeting:
- Approve canary to continue to 50k requests/day if no regressions after two more days of testing. Owner: Liam.
- Ship Console backend change as a minor release (toggle gated behind feature flag) and plan small UI follow-up in two sprints. Owner: Priya (console PM) and Liam (eng).
- Start security review for KMS private flow this sprint; assign SRE to draft HSM threat model. Owner: Nora to kick off, security to respond by 03/20.

Potential quick asks (if we have time):
- Ask SRE for a short runbook snippet for private failover (where to toggle fallback to hosted models).
- Request Product Ops to draft one-pager for sales on cost/latency tradeoffs for quantized models.

Risks / open blocks (to call out explicitly):
- Risk: If canary workload doesn't include cold-start prefixes, p95 looks better than production. Need synthetic traffic with cold prefixes.
- Block: Private KMS integration needs vault access from customer side — might delay by 2+ weeks.

Post-meeting follow-ups (planned format: short Jira tasks + 1-line summary in release notes):
- ACTION: Create ENG ticket to add cold-prefix synthetic workload to canary suite. Owner: Liam, due: 2026-03-17.
- ACTION: Console backend PR scope doc and feature-flag plan. Owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-19.
- ACTION: Security kickoff for private KMS/HSM integration + deliverable: threat model. Owner: Nora (request), Security eng assigned, due: 2026-03-20.
- ACTION: Product ops one-pager on quantization tradeoffs (customer-facing). Owner: Nora -> POps, due: 2026-03-23.

Quick follow-up template to send after meeting:
- TL;DR: decisions and owners (3 bullets)
- Metrics to watch for next 48h (list with thresholds)
- Jira links for immediate actions + due dates
- Ask: any blockers I should escalate to Prod/Eng leadership?

Loose scratch ideas (brainstorm snippets):
- Could we add a lightweight toggle in Console for "prefer cost" vs "prefer latency" per-route so sales can demo different profiles? Minimal UX: radio + tooltip; backend: route policy.
- Explore running quantized variants on Dedicated reserved pools during low hours to show cost delta in demos.

End notes (personal):
- Bring coffee. Keep the meeting tight. If canary looks bad, escalate immediately — don't let it slip into experimental period.
- After meeting: push a short status note to #prod-updates and tag the sales demo thread if Console change is approved.

---
Version history (notes):
- 2026-03-11: initial draft prep
- 2026-03-12: added canary questions and action-item templates
- 2026-03-13: finalize owners + dates before meeting
